Description.TranslatedText: SITEID, unless the site has fewer than 3 randomized subjects in any treatment arm; those sites are pooled into '900'. Screen failures get the SITEGR1 of their site.
TRT01P = ARM (planned arm). Null for screen failures (reason in ARMNRS).
TRT01A = ACTARM (actual arm). 12 subjects were treated differently from the planned arm. Null for screen failures.
Numeric code of the treatment: Placebo = 0, Xanomeline Low Dose = 54, Xanomeline High Dose = 81 (target daily dose in mg).
Numeric date of DM.RFXSTDTC (first patch application).
Numeric date of DM.RFXENDTC. If missing, numeric date of DM.RFENDTC. See COM.ADSL.TRTEDT.
Sum over EX records of EXDOSE * (EXENDT - EXSTDT + 1), planned daily dose times actual days. A missing EXENDTC on the last EX record is replaced by TRTEDT. Placebo = 0.
WHITE = 1, BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN = 2, ASIAN = 3, OTHER = 4.
'Y' if DM.ARMCD is not null (randomized), else 'N'.
'Y' if ITTFL = 'Y' and TRTSDT is not null (at least one patch applied), else 'N'.

'Y' if ITTFL = 'Y' and the subject has a baseline (VISITNUM 3) ADAS-Cog assessment, at least one post-baseline (VISITNUM > 3) ADAS-Cog assessment, and at least one post-baseline CIBIC+ (ADCS-CGIC) assessment, else 'N'. An assessment counts when the QS record exists and QSSTAT is null.
COMP8FL, COMP16FL, COMP24FL = 'Y' if SV has an attended record (SVPRESP = 'Y') for the scheduled visit VISITNUM 8, 10, 12 (Week 8, 16, 24), else 'N'.

From DS where DSCAT = 'DISPOSITION EVENT' and DSSCAT = 'STUDY TREATMENT'. EOTSTT = 'COMPLETED' if DSDECOD = 'COMPLETED', else 'DISCONTINUED'. DCTREAS = DSDECOD when EOTSTT = 'DISCONTINUED', else null.

From DS where DSCAT = 'DISPOSITION EVENT' and DSSCAT = 'STUDY PARTICIPATION'. EOSSTT = 'COMPLETED' if DSDECOD = 'COMPLETED', else 'DISCONTINUED'. EOSDT = numeric date of DSSTDTC. DCSREAS = DSDECOD when EOSSTT = 'DISCONTINUED', else null.
VS.VSSTRESN where VSTESTCD = 'HEIGHT' and VISITNUM = 1 (Screening 1), per SAP 9.2 (cm).
VS.VSSTRESN where VSTESTCD = 'WEIGHT' and VISITNUM = 3 (Baseline, Week 0), per SAP 9.2 (kg).
Numeric date of SV.SVSTDTC where VISITNUM = 1 (Screening 1).
Numeric date of DS.DSSTDTC where DSDECOD = 'RANDOMIZED'.
Numeric date of MH.MHSTDTC where MHCAT = 'PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS' (Alzheimer's disease). A missing month or day is set to the first of the month or year. See COM.ADSL.DISONSDT.
Sum of QS.QSSTRESN for QSTESTCD MMITM01-MMITM06 where QSLOBXFL = 'Y' (Screening 1). Null if any item is missing.

Numeric date of AE.AESTDTC. Partial dates: YYYY-MM -> first of the month, ASTDTF = 'D'; YYYY -> January 1, ASTDTF = 'M'. If the partial date falls in the same month (or year) as TRTSDT, TRTSDT is used instead. ASTDTF is null for a complete date.
Numeric date of AE.AEENDTC. Null when AEENDTC is blank (event ongoing or end date not collected); not imputed.
ASTDY, AENDY = date - TRTSDT + 1 if date >= TRTSDT, else date - TRTSDT. Null if either date is missing.
AENDT - ASTDT + 1 in days. Null if either date is missing.
'Y' if ASTDT >= TRTSDT, else null. Treatment emergent = starts on or after the start of treatment (CSR Table 14-5.01 note).

Among records with TRTEMFL = 'Y', sorted by USUBJID, ASTDT, AESEQ: AOCCFL = 'Y' on the first record of each USUBJID; AOCCSFL on the first of each USUBJID and AEBODSYS; AOCCPFL on the first of each USUBJID, AEBODSYS and AEDECOD; AOCC01FL on the first of each USUBJID where CQ01NAM is not null. Else null.
'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' if AEDECOD is one of the 32 preferred terms in CSR Table 12-2 (codelist CQ01TERM), else null.
ADT - TRTSDT + 1 if ADT >= TRTSDT, else ADT - TRTSDT. Null if either date is missing.
PARAMCD = VSTESTCD. PARAM = VSTEST || ' (' || VSSTRESU || ')', e.g. 'Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)'. Only records with VSSTRESN not null are kept.
From LB where LBCAT = 'CHEMISTRY' and LBSTRESN is not null. PARAMCD = LBTESTCD. PARAM = LBTEST || ' (' || LBSTRESU || ')'; just LBTEST when LBSTRESU is null.
From LB where LBCAT = 'HEMATOLOGY' and LBSTRESN is not null. PARAMCD = LBTESTCD. PARAM = LBTEST || ' (' || LBSTRESU || ')'; just LBTEST when LBSTRESU is null.

Assigned from the CRF visit (SAP 8.2): the baseline record (ABLFL = 'Y') -> 'Baseline' (0); VISITNUM 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 -> 'Week 2', 'Week 4', 'Week 6', 'Week 8', 'Week 12', 'Week 16', 'Week 20', 'Week 24', 'Week 26' (AVISITN = week number). All other records (screening, unscheduled, ambulatory ECG, retrieval, AE follow-up) are kept with AVISIT null.
'Y' on the VISITNUM 3 (Baseline, Week 0) record for each USUBJID, PARAMCD, ATPTN; VISITNUM 1 (Screening 1) for HEIGHT. Per SAP 9.2 and 11.6. No baseline if that visit is missing.
'Y' on the VISITNUM 1 (Screening 1, Week -2) record for each USUBJID, PARAMCD, per SAP 11.5. No baseline if that visit is missing.
AVAL of the ABLFL = 'Y' record of the same USUBJID, PARAMCD (and ATPTN in ADVS).
AVAL - BASE for post-baseline records (AVISITN > 0). Null for the baseline record and when BASE is null.
CHG / BASE * 100. Null if BASE is null or 0.
'Y' on one record per USUBJID, PARAMCD (and ATPTN), AVISITN where AVISIT is not null: the latest ADT, then the highest --SEQ. Records with AVISIT null are not flagged.
End of treatment record: 'Y' on the ANL01FL = 'Y' record with the highest AVISITN between 2 and 24 (last post-baseline scheduled value on or before Week 24) per USUBJID, PARAMCD (and ATPTN).
R2A1LO = AVAL / A1LO; R2A1HI = AVAL / A1HI. Null if the limit is null or 0.
Per SAP 8.3: AVAL <= A1LO -> 'LOW'; AVAL >= A1HI -> 'HIGH'; otherwise 'NORMAL'. Null if both limits are null. (Differs from LBNRIND at the limits: SDTM uses < and >.)
ANRIND of the ABLFL = 'Y' record of the same USUBJID, PARAMCD.

For ANL01FL = 'Y' post-baseline records: 'Y' if ABS(AVAL - AVAL of the previous ANL01FL = 'Y' record of the same parameter) > 0.5 * (A1HI - A1LO); 'N' otherwise; null if there is no previous record or a limit is null.
'Y' if AVISITN is between 2 and 24 (planned visits after Week 0 up to and including Week 24, SAP 11.5), else null.

TTDE - event: earliest ASTDT among ADAE records with CQ01NAM = 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENTS' and TRTEMFL = 'Y'; CNSR = 0, EVNTDESC = 'DERMATOLOGIC EVENT', SRCDOM = 'ADAE', SRCVAR = 'ASTDT', SRCSEQ = AESEQ. No event: ADT = ADSL.EOSDT; CNSR = 1, EVNTDESC = 'END OF STUDY', SRCDOM = 'ADSL', SRCVAR = 'EOSDT'. TTDISC - ADT = ADSL.TRTEDT; CNSR = 0 and EVNTDESC = 'TREATMENT DISCONTINUED' if ADSL.EOTSTT = 'DISCONTINUED'; CNSR = 1 and EVNTDESC = 'TREATMENT COMPLETED' otherwise. SRCDOM = 'ADSL', SRCVAR = 'TRTEDT'.

Items: QS.QSSTRESN. ACTOT: ADAS-Cog(11) total (SAP 14.1.1, 14.2): sum of QSSTRESN for ACITM01, 02, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 11, 12, 13, 14 per USUBJID, VISITNUM, QSDTC (items 03, 09 and 10 belong to ADAS-Cog(14) only). Item maximums: 10, 5, 5, 5, 5, 8, 12, 5, 5, 5, 5 (total 70). If 4 or more items are missing (more than 30%), AVAL is null. If 1 to 3 items are missing, AVAL = sum of present items * 70 / (70 - sum of the maximums of the missing items).
'Y' on the record with AVISIT = 'Baseline' and ANL01FL = 'Y'.

Analysis visits by study day (SAP 8.2), on all records including unscheduled and retrieval (VISITNUM 201) visits; assessments after the last dose are kept (SAP 10). ADAS-Cog: Baseline ADY <= 1 (target 1); Week 8 ADY 2-84 (56); Week 16 85-140 (112); Week 24 >= 141 (168). CIBIC+: Week 8, 16, 24 with the same windows (no baseline). AVISITN = week number (Baseline 0). AWTARGET = target day, AWTDIFF = ABS(ADY - AWTARGET), AWLO/AWHI = window limits (null when open), AWRANGE as text e.g. '2-84'. ANL01FL = 'Y' on the record with the smallest AWTDIFF in each window per USUBJID; on a tie, the earlier ADT.

For PARAMCD = 'ACTOT' and EFFFL = 'Y' subjects only: for each post-baseline analysis visit (Week 8, 16, 24) without an ANL01FL = 'Y' record, a new record is added with DTYPE = 'LOCF', AVISIT/AVISITN/AWxxx of the missing visit, and AVAL, ADT, ADY, VISITNUM, VISIT copied from the latest earlier post-baseline ANL01FL = 'Y' record. ANL01FL = 'Y'. The baseline value is not carried forward. DTYPE is null for observed records.
Threshold range category (SAP 8.3): AVAL < 0.5 * A1LO -> 'LOW'; AVAL > 1.5 * A1HI -> 'HIGH'; otherwise 'NORMAL'. Null if both limits are null. Used for the threshold shift tables.
AVALCAT1 of the ABLFL = 'Y' record of the same USUBJID, PARAMCD.
AEREL PROBABLE or POSSIBLE -> 'RELATED'; REMOTE or NONE -> 'NOT RELATED'; null AEREL -> 'RELATED' (conservative).

Among records with TRTEMFL = 'Y', sorted by AESEVN descending, ASTDT, AESEQ: AOCCIFL = 'Y' on the first record of each USUBJID (the most severe event); AOCCSIFL on the first of each USUBJID, AEBODSYS; AOCCPIFL on the first of each USUBJID, AEBODSYS, AEDECOD. Else null.
'Y' if the AE record is linked in RELREC (RELID = 'DSAE', IDVAR = AESPID) to the DS record with DSSCAT = 'STUDY TREATMENT' and DSDECOD = 'ADVERSE EVENT', else null.
Two parameters per safety subject: TTDE 'Time to First Dermatologic Event (Days)' and TTDISC 'Time to Treatment Discontinuation (Days)'.

PARAMCD ACTOT 'ADAS-Cog(11) Total Score', plus the 11 items used in the total (PARAMCD = QSTESTCD: ACITM01, 02, 04-08, 11-14) so the total can be traced to its items. Items 03, 09, 10 (ADAS-Cog(14) only) are not included.
TRANSHY 'ALT or AST >1.5 x ULN'; BILIHY 'Bilirubin >1.5 x ULN'; HYLAW 'ALT or AST >1.5 x ULN and Bilirubin >1.5 x ULN' (modified Hy's law, SAP 8.3).

From ADLBC records with ANL01FL = 'Y' (or ABLFL = 'Y') and PARAMCD in ALT, AST, BILI, per USUBJID and AVISITN. TRANSHY = 'Y' if R2A1HI > 1.5 for ALT or AST, 'N' if at least one of them is present. BILIHY = 'Y' if BILI R2A1HI > 1.5, 'N' if BILI is present. HYLAW = 'Y' if TRANSHY and BILIHY are both 'Y', 'N' if both are present. AVAL = 1 for 'Y', 0 for 'N'. ADT = latest ADT of the source records. No record when the source values are missing.
AVALC/AVAL of the ABLFL = 'Y' record of the same USUBJID, PARAMCD.

For MHCAT other than 'PRIMARY DIAGNOSIS' (not coded), sorted by USUBJID, MHBODSYS, MHDECOD, MHSEQ: AOCCSFL = 'Y' on the first record of each USUBJID, MHBODSYS; AOCCPFL on the first of each USUBJID, MHBODSYS, MHDECOD. Else null.

ADSL has all 306 screened subjects, including 52 screen failures (ITTFL = 'N'). Screen failures have DM, DS and SV data only, so treatment, baseline and treatment-status variables are null for them. Analyses select subjects with ITTFL, SAFFL or EFFFL. The Pilot ADSL has only the 254 randomized subjects.
DM.RFXENDTC is null for 6 randomized subjects (no final dose date recorded). For all 6, DM.RFENDTC equals the date of the last visit in SV, so it is used instead.
Efficacy population as in the CSR: ITT subjects with baseline and at least one post-baseline ADAS-Cog and CIBIC+ assessment. 234 of 254 subjects.
One subject has only the year of diagnosis (YYYY); it is set to January 1.
All AE records of ADSL subjects are kept. TRTEMFL marks the treatment-emergent ones.
Imputation of a partial start date never moves the event before the first dose when the dates cannot be told apart, so the event is counted as treatment emergent.
ANL01FL marks the one record used for by-visit summaries.
ANL02FL marks the end of treatment record (SAP 11.6: last on-treatment assessment on or before the Week 24 visit). It is a flag on an existing record, not a copied record.
Urinalysis and other lab tests (TSH, vitamin B12, HbA1c) are not summarized (SAP 11.5) and are not in ADLBC/ADLBH.
Lab baseline is Screening 1 (Week -2) as in SAP 11.5, not the SDTM LBLOBXFL (last value before first dose, which can be an unscheduled retest).
Efficacy records are assigned to analysis visits by study day, not by CRF visit (SAP 8.2). Efficacy analyses use TRTP (planned treatment) and EFFFL.

Action taken with study treatment (AEACN) was not collected on the AE page. The AE that led to stopping treatment is named on the Patient Summary page and linked to DS through RELREC; this flag uses that link.
